{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A refined wool-blend knit in charcoal gray with a subtle herringbone texture, cut as an oversized mockneck top reaching mid-hip in length, color #36454F.
Tailored wool trousers in matching charcoal with a straight-leg silhouette and a slight kick at the hem, falling just above the ankle, color #2F3840.
Leather ankle boots in deep espresso brown with a low stacked heel and a soft square toe, crafted from smooth full-grain leather, color #3B1E1E.

This ensemble captures the essence of professional autumn wear while adhering to the requested "neat" dress code for an office setting. The charcoal knit provides warmth during cool fall days without needing an outer layer due to the moderate temperatures expected indoors or on mild mornings. The straight-leg wool trousers offer structure and polish, grounding the outfit in a refined business aesthetic that commands respect yet remains comfortable for a full workday. Completing the look with espresso leather boots bridges the seasonal gap between summer footwear and winter heaviness, ensuring style meets practicality in a corporate environment."}
